title: SHR, AND_WORD, OR_WORD, XOR_WORD, NOT_WORD and their DWORD forms use the full width
note: IEC 61131-3, bit shift and bitwise functions, and CMP-014: with W = 16#F0F0 and D = 16#F0F0F0F0, SHR(W, 4) = 16#0F0F, W AND 16#00FF = 16#00F0, W OR 16#000F = 16#F0FF, W XOR 16#FFFF = 16#0F0F and NOT W = 16#0F0F; D AND 16#FFFF = 16#F0F0, D OR 16#FF = 16#F0F0F0FF, D XOR 16#FFFFFFFF = 16#0F0F0F0F and NOT D = 16#0F0F0F0F
